subject: general
question: Who is the director of the Indian film ‘Tanvi: The Great’, which had its world premiere at the Cannes Film Market during the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anupam Kher**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anupam Kher** is a renowned Indian actor, director, and producer who has worked in multiple Indian and international films.
 
• He has won several prestigious awards, including **two National Film Awards** and **eight Filmfare Awards** for his exceptional performances.
 
• Anupam Kher is known for his diverse roles in Bollywood and Hollywood. He is also celebrated for his contributions to Indian theatre and cinema.
 
• His film '**Tanvi: The Great**' premiered at the **78th Cannes Film Festival**, a prestigious global platform for showcasing cinematic excellence.
 
• The Cannes Film Market is an integral part of the Cannes Film Festival, allowing filmmakers to network, showcase their work, and gain international recognition.
 
• The premiere of '**Tanvi: The Great**' at such a significant event underlines Anupam Kher’s ability to create meaningful and globally appreciated cinema.
 
• Anupam Kher has also been a recipient of the **Padma Shri** (2004) and **Padma Bhushan** (2016), two of India’s highest civilian honors, for his contribution to the arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kiran Rao**__

 __
 
• **Kiran Rao** is an Indian filmmaker, screenwriter, and producer.
 
• She is known for her debut directorial film **'Dhobi Ghat'** (2010) and her contribution as a producer for movies like **'Lagaan'** and **'Dangal'.**
 
 
 
• **Shabana Azmi**__
 __
 
• **Shabana Azmi** is a legendary Indian actress known for her work in **parallel cinema**.
 
• She has won **five National Film Awards** for Best Actress and is a recipient of the **Padma Shri** and **Padma Bhushan**.
 
 
 
• **Naseeruddin Shah**__
 
 
• **Naseeruddin Shah** is a veteran actor in Indian cinema, known for his work in **theatre, parallel cinema, and mainstream Bollywood.**
 
• He is a recipient of the **Padma Shri**, **Padma Bhushan**, and multiple **National Film Awards.**
